title: Multi-day MI-BCI dataset (WBCIC-SHU) from Yang et al 2025
description: A multi-day motor imagery brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 51 healthy participants across 3 sessions. The dataset includes 2-class (left/right hand imagery) and 3-class (left hand, right hand, foot) motor imagery tasks with standardized visual and auditory cues. This high-quality dataset contains 39,600 trials acquired at 1000 Hz using 59 EEG channels and is designed for benchmarking BCI classification algorithms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuracle NeuSen W system at 1000 Hz sampling rate with 59 EEG channels arranged in the standard 10-05 montage, plus ECG and EOG channels. Participants performed motor imagery tasks cued by visual and auditory stimuli with 1.5 s cue duration followed by 4.0 s imagery period. Data were collected across 3 sessions per subject on different days. Online bandpass filtering (0.5-40 Hz) and 50 Hz line frequency notch filtering were applied during acquisition.
